invalid_harness_attempts.label: attempt1_invalid_csv
invalid_harness_attempts.reason: GNU date --iso-8601=ns emitted a comma before fractional seconds, producing one extra CSV field in telemetry and NPU-load rows.

invalid_harness_attempts.label: attempt2_invalid_csv
invalid_harness_attempts.reason: Setting LC_ALL=C did not change this coreutils date output; the same extra CSV field remained.

fix.change: Replace date --iso-8601=ns with an explicit %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%N%:z format.
fix.targeted_check: A one-row board probe reported 27 header fields and 27 data fields before the adopted run.
